# RESTORE

Bring back the settings and folder the last PRESERVE stored.

## Syntax

```text
RESTORE.
```

Words after RESTORE are ignored with a warning.

## Example

```text
RESTORE.
```

`statscraft help RESTORE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
